title: A Dusty Trip Music IDs
seo_title: A Dusty Trip Music IDs [33 Radio Songs]
meta_description: Find 33 A Dusty Trip music IDs for the car radio. Check Car Radio access, song details and why a track may stay silent.
intro_md: An A Dusty Trip Music ID is a number for a Roblox audio track. There are 33 IDs here, but the car radio may not accept every one. Try a number only when your vehicle's radio shows an ID field.
description_md:
## What are A Dusty Trip music IDs?

An A Dusty Trip Music ID is the number that identifies a Roblox song. It may also be called a radio code or song code, but it is not a reward code and it does not give you fuel, coins, vehicles, or supplies. Songs show a title, artist and duration when those details are available, with cover art on some rows.

## How to use music IDs in A Dusty Trip

1. Join [A Dusty Trip on Roblox](https://www.roblox.com/games/16389395869/a-dusty-trip).
2. Buy the Car Radio pass in the in-game shop. It costs about 129 Robux, but prices change, so check the shop before you buy.
3. Build or enter a vehicle, then open the radio on the dashboard.
4. If the radio has an ID field, paste the number for the song you want.
5. Confirm the song and adjust the game or Roblox volume if needed.

The controls can change with updates and may not match on every device. If there is no ID field, use the controls provided by the live game rather than assuming the number is invalid.

## Three songs tied to the game and 30 car radio songs players share

Western Canyon, Spooky Ride and Heat Haze are the three songs tied to A Dusty Trip on Roblox. The other 30 are car radio songs that players share for the game.

A song's connection to A Dusty Trip does not make it part of the official soundtrack.
how_it_works_md:
## Why an A Dusty Trip song might not play

- **The radio changed.** Game updates can change the radio controls. The current vehicle may use a built-in list or have no manual field.
- **The song is restricted.** Roblox can moderate, make private, remove or limit a song.
- **Car Radio access is missing.** Check the shop and your vehicle menu.
- **The ID was copied wrong.** Paste only the digits into a numeric field.
- **Your audio is muted.** Check the game, Roblox and device volume.

If a song stays silent after you check these, try a different one.

faq_json.q: Are these guaranteed working A Dusty Trip radio codes?
faq_json.a: No. The Car Radio must accept the ID, and both the pass and Roblox audio permissions can affect playback.

faq_json.q: Where do I enter an A Dusty Trip Music ID?
faq_json.a: Open the radio on your vehicle's dashboard and paste only the digits into the ID field. If the dashboard has no ID field, use the built-in controls the game shows.

faq_json.q: Do I need Car Radio access?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Car Radio pass unlocks the in-game car radio. Prices and button labels can change, so check the in-game shop and your vehicle's controls.

faq_json.q: Why does my A Dusty Trip song stay silent?
faq_json.a: The song may be removed or made private, the radio may not take typed IDs, the Car Radio pass may be missing, or the volume may be muted. Try a different song, then check the volume in the game, in Roblox and on your device.

faq_json.q: Are these official A Dusty Trip soundtrack songs?
faq_json.a: Not necessarily. A song's connection to A Dusty Trip doesn't make it part of the official soundtrack.

faq_json.q: Can I use these IDs in other Roblox games?
faq_json.a: Maybe. The 30 car radio songs are public Creator Store audio, which is free to use across games. A song may play in another game with a radio that takes IDs, but that game's radio and the song's permissions still decide.
